plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: (1) A check of the requester's category rule (C3). No instrument tests category values, so a wrong category would pass every answer in this plan. (2) A check of the live tables after promotion. Same set and summary of the change read only the staged set, so C1, C2 and C4 are shown only for the staged state. (3) An outbox check for C10. Sent as released reads confirmed calls, not outbox rows. Trace of a call exists only on named lines during the work, at 10 each, so the allowance of 50 covers about 5 of the 100 sending calls. (4) Scope of a call for C5. It is available only on named lines during the work, and the allowance covers about 5 of the 101 reads. The plan stays at 180 and leaves 20 unused. Those 20 would not buy a further instrument at any approval, because same set and summary of the change at A2 and A3 would only restate the A1 answers on the staged set. Undo rehearsal at A1 must be followed by the promotion within one hour, or it is no longer relied on.
